rows.grounds: optative of juh (offer) as prescribed in context

items.question: How should oblations be offered to the chief limbs according to their repetitions?
premises: Oblations are offered to chief limbs.
items.inference: The rite prescribes ordered offerings to chief limbs by repetition count.
uncertainties: Exact number of repetitions is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should offer oblations to the chief limbs in order, according to their repetitions.
